name: FF Admin - Content Request Intake - Draft

nodes.name: Platform Content Request Webhook
nodes.notes: Webhook is intentionally draft/inactive. Protect with signature validation before activation.

nodes.name: Capture And Validate CP Request
nodes.notes: Validates the CP request and preserves the original payload for post-response processing.

nodes.name: Respond To Platform
nodes.notes: Returns a safe acknowledgement or dry-run result.

nodes.name: Build Approved Evidence And Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds approved evidence, restrictions, and a strict JSON-only prompt.

nodes.name: Generate Text Output
nodes.notes: Calls an OpenAI-compatible LLM if LLM_TOKEN is configured; otherwise returns a safe deterministic draft.

nodes.name: Validate And Sanitize Output
nodes.notes: Validates LLM output against hard safety rules and replaces unsafe text with a safe fallback.

nodes.name: Prepare Signed Content Callback
nodes.notes: Builds a signed content-generation callback after text generation and validation.

nodes.name: Send Signed Callback To CP
nodes.notes: Sends mock completion back to the CP callback endpoint. Requires PLATFORM_CALLBACK_SECRET to be available to n8n as an environment variable.
